title: Administrator - Construction
description:
Retrofit Administrator
Location: Peterborough
Salary: 28,000 - 32,000
Job Type: Full-Time, Permanent

About Us

We are a well-established maintenance and property services contractor delivering high-quality repairs, maintenance, and retrofit programmes across residential properties. Due to continued growth and increasing demand within the energy efficiency sector, we are seeking an organised and proactive Retrofit Administrator to support the successful delivery of our retrofit projects.

The Role

As a Retrofit Administrator, you will play a key role in supporting the retrofit team, ensuring projects are administered efficiently and comply with industry standards and funding requirements. You will work closely with Retrofit Coordinators, Assessors, Site Teams, Clients, and Residents to maintain accurate records and facilitate smooth project delivery.

Key Responsibilities
- Provide administrative support for retrofit and energy efficiency programmes.
- Manage project documentation, ensuring records are accurate, complete, and compliant.
- Schedule surveys, assessments, installations, and inspections.
- Liaise with residents, clients, subcontractors, and internal teams regarding appointments and project updates.
- Maintain retrofit project trackers and databases.
- Process and upload documentation to client portals and compliance systems.
- Monitor project milestones and assist with reporting requirements.
- Support the preparation of funding and compliance evidence packs.
- Handle incoming enquiries and provide excellent customer service.
- Assist the Retrofit Coordinator and project management team with day-to-day administration.

Requirements
- Previous experience in an administrative role, ideally within construction, maintenance, social housing, or retrofit sectors.
- Strong organisational skills with excellent attention to detail.
- Proficient in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Outlook, and Word.
- Ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines effectively.
- Excellent communication and customer service skills.
- Experience working with compliance documentation and client portals would be advantageous.
- Knowledge of PAS 2035, ECO4, SHDF, or retrofit programmes would be beneficial but not essential as training can be provided.

What We Offer
- Competitive salary.
- Company pension scheme.
- Ongoing training and development opportunities.
- Career progression within a growing business.
- Supportive and collaborative working environment.
- Opportunity to contribute to projects that improve energy efficiency and sustainability.

How to Apply

If you are a highly organised administrator looking to develop your career within the growing retrofit and energy efficiency sector, we would love to hear from you. Please submit your CV along with a brief cover letter outlining your relevant experience.

title: Customer Order Administrator
description:
Customer Order Administrator

Peterborough (Hybrid - 3 days onsite per week)

Pay Rate: 13.49 per hour

Starting August/September 2026

We are currently recruiting for a Customer Order Administrator to join a busy and supportive Customer Order Management team on a 6-month temporary contract based in Peterborough.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with previous administration, order processing, data entry or other transferable experience would be beneficial.

This role is focused on ensuring customer orders are processed accurately and efficiently while supporting the administration of the full order lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities
- Process customer orders accurately and within agreed deadlines.
- Manually allocate parts to customer orders using internal systems.
- Prepare export and shipping documentation.
- Support data entry across the order lifecycle, including new customer set-up and credit/debit administration.
- Maintain and cleanse system data, including customer records, pricing and order holds.
- Produce and distribute standard internal reports.
- Carry out general administrative duties, including filing, scanning and document management.
- Identify and escalate issues or exceptions where appropriate.
- Suggest process improvements to support continuous improvement initiatives.

To be successful in this role, you'll have:
- Previous administration, order processing, data entry or other transferable experience
- Excellent attention to detail and a high level of accuracy.
- Good Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel, Word and Outlook.
- The ability to work efficiently with structured and repetitive tasks.
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage your workload and meet deadlines.
- A proactive attitude and willingness to learn new systems and processes.

title: Medical Receptionist/ Administrator
description: Dr Laliwala and Partners are looking for an experienced or quick learner, enthusiastic and patient-focused Medical Receptionist/Administrator to join our friendly team at Nightingale Medical Centre. The successful candidate will play an important role in supporting the day-to-day running of the practice, providing excellent service to our patients and working closely with our clinical and administrative teams. We are looking for someone who is organised, flexible, a strong team player and able to work effectively in a busy GP practice environment. Previous experience within a GP practice or healthcare setting would be desirable. The Medical Receptionist/Administrator will provide an efficient and professional reception and administrative service to patients and the wider practice team. Main duties will include answering telephone calls, managing appointment requests, responding to patient enquiries, signposting patients to the appropriate service and processing online and electronic requests. The role will also involve updating patient records on SystmOne, processing registrations, data entry and supporting general administrative tasks. The successful candidate will work closely with clinical and non-clinical colleagues to ensure patients receive a helpful, efficient and high-quality service. Flexibility will be required to provide cover at our other practice sites when necessary. Job Description Medical Receptionist / Administrator The Medical Receptionist/Administrator will be responsible for providing a professional, efficient and welcoming service to patients, visitors and colleagues. The post holder will support the smooth day-to-day running of the practice and work closely with both clinical and non-clinical members of the team. The duties and responsibilities of the role will include: Answer incoming telephone calls promptly and professionally, dealing with patient enquiries appropriately and transferring calls when required. Process face-to-face, telephone and online/electronic requests from patients. Maintain and monitor the practice appointment system, booking, cancelling and amending appointments as appropriate. Signpost patients to the most appropriate healthcare professional, service or source of support. Respond to enquiries and requests from patients, colleagues and external organisations in a professional and timely manner. Provide a welcoming and helpful reception service to patients and visitors attending the practice. Accurately update and maintain patient healthcare records using SystmOne. Read code information onto patient records where appropriate. Process new patient and temporary patient registrations and ensure relevant information is recorded accurately. Undertake general data entry and administrative duties as required. Process incoming correspondence and direct requests such as Subject Access Requests (SARs), insurance reports, solicitor requests and DVLA forms to the appropriate administrative team. Photocopy, scan and process documentation as required. Manage general patient and practice queries efficiently and appropriately. Support clinical and non-clinical colleagues with general administrative tasks as required. Maintain a clean, tidy and effective reception and working environment. Monitor and maintain the reception area and patient notice boards. Maintain patient confidentiality and comply with information governance and data protection requirements at all times. Follow practice policies, procedures and protocols and contribute to maintaining a safe working environment. Work collaboratively as part of the wider practice team and provide support and cover to colleagues when required. Attend practice meetings and undertake relevant training as required. Provide cover at other practice sites when required due to operational needs, staff absence or sickness. The post holder will be expected to demonstrate flexibility and undertake other reasonable duties appropriate to the role as required by the Practice Manager or Partners. This job description is intended as a guide to the main responsibilities of the post and may be reviewed and amended from time to time to reflect the changing needs of the practice.
